results.reason: Identifies the Aug 16, 2026 deadline as passed with no notice sent, expiration on Nov 14, 2026 before the Nov 30 closing, and that the MIPA §3.12(c) rep ('through November 2029') and Schedule 3.12 are inaccurate, exposing Sellers to indemnity claims.

Identifies the Change of Control under §1.3/§14.2 requiring Velloran's prior written consent and the §14.3 termination right. Notes the consent is omitted from Schedule 3.6, §6.4 and §7.1(d), and recommends adding it and obtaining consent before closing.

Identifies Side Letter §1.1 adding NY and VA, precedence under §19.4, and the six-state non-compete (including the 18-month post-term period) versus four-state exclusivity. Recommends conforming the definition or expanding exclusivity.

Identifies Side Letter §6.1/6.2 New York law and New York County courts conflicting with DA §18.1/18.2 Delaware. Explains the risk of parallel proceedings and inconsistent results, and recommends conforming to Delaware.
States the Initial Term ends November 14, 2026, from the November 15, 2023 Effective Date.
States the Target Closing Date is November 30, 2026.
States the Territory is Delaware, Maryland, New Jersey and Pennsylvania.
Memo is addressed to the Supervising Partner. Each issue gives the document and section, why it matters, and a recommendation.
Issues are ordered most significant first, and an 'Items to raise promptly' table flags client and Quillon's counsel.
Expressly states the renewal right lapsed, the agreement does not renew automatically, and a notice now would be untimely.
Expressly states the Velloran consent is not on Schedule 3.6 and is not covered by §6.4 or §7.1(d).
